title: Reject discovery for unknown 0200::/8
close_reason: Fixed: Added YGGDRASIL_PREFIX (0200::/8) check in LoadngRouter.originate_rreq() that rejects discovery for addresses in this prefix without prior gradient evidence. Added 3 tests: yggdrasil_without_evidence_rejected, yggdrasil_with_evidence_allowed, ula_without_evidence_allowed. Per spec B2, LOADng MUST NOT probe arbitrary 0200::/8 destinations.
